tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Bianchi Identity]

↗ def:dc-ch4-2-1 ↗ def:dc-ch2-3-4 ↗ lem:dc-ch0-5-3-jacobi

1. ch4:2.4\[ R(X,Y)Z+R(Y,Z)X+R(Z,X)Y=0. \]
Proof

\sketch Expanding the definition and using torsion-freeness gives

\[ egin{aligned} R(X,Y)Z+R(Y,Z)X+R(Z,X)Y& = abla _Y abla _X Z- abla _X abla _Y Z+ abla _{[X,Y]}Z\ & \quad + abla _Z abla _Y X- abla _Y abla _Z X+ abla _{[Y,Z]}X\ & \quad + abla _X abla _Z Y- abla _Z abla _X Y+ abla _{[Z,X]}Y\ & = abla _Y[X,Z]+ abla _Z[Y,X]+ abla _X[Z,Y]- abla _{[X,Z]}Y- abla _{[Y,X]}Z- abla _{[Z,Y]}X\ & =[Y,[X,Z]]+[Z,[Y,X]]+[X,[Z,Y]]=0,\end{aligned} \]

where the last equality follows from the Jacobi identity for vector fields. $ lacksquare $

□
